description: A closed tank 0.6 x 0.6 m (dx 5 mm) with a baffle (S 10, 4 cells thick, x 0.40-0.42 m) from the lid down to z = 0.15 m, which closes the air of the right chamber; the free surface starts tilted, higher on the right (F 57), two phases with the compressible air (N 40 5, N 59 2, W 32 2). cfd_2d_utube_baffle_d32 on 2 ranks: the closed faces at the partition boundary (the solid level set of the halo cells), the velocities of the closed halo faces set 0 on both sides.
